blocks.html: When a mission ends, back up your team's shared CryptDrive so you can carry it to your next Deploy App server — or retire it safely.

slides.title: Back up your data
slides.html: From the team's Settings menu you can easily back up the team's shared CryptDrive. When your mission ends, take a backup — you can upload it to your next Deploy App CryptPad server or another system as needed. Remember safe data handling!
